Exaggerate anticipation, body compression, torso twist and follow-through; sudden fast release, a brief emphatic impact hold, then controlled recovery to the original stance. The arc is a motion trace, not another sword. Keep exactly one sword and the same warrior proportions and clothing. Same front three-quarter view, attack screen-left. Keep boots in the same cell.
